description: Shield yourself from the elements with Rothco’s Multi-Use Neck Gaiter and Face Covering Tactical Wrap, featuring a bold skull print design. This adaptable piece of headwear offers over a dozen different ways to wear it, including as a head wrap, scarf, balaclava, bandana, or neck gaiter. Made from soft, breathable, and moisture-wicking material, it helps keep you cool and dry, even during intense outdoor activities. Its wind-resistant properties offer added protection against harsh conditions, while the lightweight, seamless tube design ensures a comfortable fit for most head sizes. Measuring 19.5 inch x 10 inch, it stretches to accommodate without irritation. The tactical wrap is easy to fold and store in your bag or pocket, making it perfect for on-the-go use. Whether you're hiking, biking, or just need protection from wind, dust, or sunlight, Rothco’s Skull Print Tactical Wrap offers both style and function in any outdoor environment.
